This watch features: The Patek Philippe brand offers watches of the highest quality matched with incredible style. The Patek Philippe Aquanaut watch (ref. 5068R-001) features a mechanical automatic movement; embossed Brown "Décor Brun" Tropical Dial with date display; center seconds hand; sapphire-crystal, transparent case back; and 35, 18k Rose gold case on a dark brown composite strap with an 18k Rose gold, Aquanaut-style deployant clasp. The Patek Philippe Aquanaut is an iconic sports watch. It’s also about the most comfortable watch a Lady can wear. The rubber strap is very soft, and the case is just the right size, neither too big nor too heavy as some sports watches are wont to be. The modified (more rounded) tonneau case shape sits on the wrist just right. The case is water resistant to 120 meters (400ft), making this a true sports watch and an excellent everyday timepiece. Rose gold case measures 35 diameter. Sapphire front and display back crystals and screw down crown. The bezel on this watch is uniquely shaped and a classic Patek design element set with 46 Diamonds. Dial is extremely gorgeous Brown "Décor Brun" Tropical, sweep seconds hand, applied Arabic numbers (hour markers and numerals have luminous) and date window at 3 o’clock. Movement is the automatic winding Patek Philippe Caliber 324 SC with 29 jewels. The strap is of fantastic quality, supple, conforming to the wrist for a perfect fit, and outfitted with a steel double folding Patek Philippe deployant clasp. An easy to overlook detail is how perfectly the strap ends and the 18kt Rose Gold case begins – it is a seamless fit between these two parts. The strap is also big enough to fit The Incredible Hulk (up to about a 10 inch wrist).
